subject: 雨中送书纵向故事

prompt: An independent vertical COMIC PAGE for a beginner art book, no words, no captions, no speech bubbles, no lettering. Depict three clearly separated sequential story beats in order top to bottom: 1 an adult male bicycle book courier with short dark hair, blue cap, red raincoat and canvas bag rides through light rain carrying a brown-paper wrapped book. 2 he brakes safely before a small green doorway, warm light visible. 3 a smiling elderly woman with silver hair and blue cardigan receives the dry parcel at the door while an orange cat watches at her feet. Maintain courier and recipient appearance consistently. Coherent rain setting and readable actions. Style: contemporary Korean-style vertical webtoon visual language. Three distinct sequential scene frames spaced apart down a tall clean page with generous white scroll gaps; first broad establishing rain scene, second close-up of hand braking with red raincoat sleeve and bluecap courier partial view, third medium warm doorway exchange. Delicate thin linework, gentle digital gradient shading and atmospheric light, more breathing room between final beats, consistent appealing adult characters. No typography no speech bubbles.
assessment: 本图白隙与近远镜头有效，仍偏写实光影，且三个片段长度有限。它说明一种彩色纵向叙事方案，不能把柔光人物当成网络漫画唯一画风。

subject: 名画转译：旋涡笔触
date_note: v1.1 修订新增；独立生成示例
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one independent square illustration for an art-style teaching book. An original quiet harbor village at night, a small lighthouse, two fishing boats, tall cypress at the edge, large stars. Inspired by the directional, rhythmic oil brushwork and blue/yellow contrast of Vincent van Gogh's 1889 The Starry Night, but make a different harbor composition, not a reproduction. Every area should have purposeful visible strokes: sky follows broad spiral currents, water follows horizontal reflection strokes, buildings short planar strokes. Avoid photographic realism or random texture overlay. No writing, signature, watermark, collage panels.
assessment: 天空旋涡、水面横痕与建筑短笔触有不同方向，蓝黄对比清楚；旋涡装饰感较强，不能据此声称复原梵高真实笔法或原作厚度。

subject: 名画转译：波与小景
date_note: v1.1 修订新增；独立生成示例
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One independent square ukiyo-e woodblock-inspired illustration for an educational book. Original scene: a powerful river wave curves over a tiny red ferry carrying three adult commuters, distant low green hills with no Mount Fuji, cream open sky. Borrow the large sweeping wave / small vulnerable human scale relationship from Hokusai's Great Wave, but do not reproduce its layout. Strong elegant ink outlines, flattened limited indigo teal cream red areas, stylized foam claws, subtle paper impression only. No photographic water, no text, no signature or panels.
assessment: 浪峰、小船和远山的尺度关系清楚，轮廓与平面色带明显；青蓝区仍有模拟渐变与纹理，部分色块不严格对应独立印版。

subject: 名画转译：点色人物
date_note: v1.1 修订新增；独立生成示例
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One independent square pointillist teaching illustration: original public park beside a lake, three adult walkers and a large red umbrella, a small dog, afternoon trees. Related to Seurat's late nineteenth-century pointillist method, but an original scene rather than reproducing La Grande Jatte. Build forms from individually visible small colored dots; different nearby dots compose light, shadow and local hue; minimal continuous contours, no uniform noise over smooth base image, no photographic faces, no lettering or signature.
assessment: 大部分人物和树叶由小点及短小色痕构形，近远尺度差明显；局部仍是较大的斑点或短痕，不是全图完全一致的圆点。

subject: 名画转译：剪形与负形
date_note: v1.1 修订新增；独立生成示例
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One independent square cut-paper-inspired teaching illustration. An original arrangement of three cobalt-blue paper swimmers with simplified limbs and abstract ochre leaf forms on warm ivory. Inspired by the compositional method of Henri Matisse's late cut-outs, not a copy of any known work. Clearly cut irregular smooth edges, flat opaque colored paper, balanced gaps and overlaps, highly simplified yet readable bodily silhouettes. No internal anatomical rendering, no gradients, no shadows suggesting 3D, no typography, signature or panels.
assessment: 三个人体与赭色叶形保持平面，白缝承担关节与形体关系；有细微纸面颗粒，不能把它当作马蒂斯真实剪贴的记录。

subject: 流行方向：动画平涂

prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One independent square original animation-style illustration: cheerful adult woman bicycle courier with short auburn hair, green helmet and orange jacket stands beside a blue bicycle at a small neighborhood bakery on a bright morning. Crisp varied outlines, flat local colors and precisely limited two-level hard-edged cel shadows, no blended skin or photographic textures; flat shapes in the environment too. subject: 流行方向：像素场景
date_note: v1.1 修订新增；独立生成示例
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One independent square pixel-art illustration of an original cozy fantasy town market at dusk: adult shopkeeper, fruit stalls, cat, tiled roofs, lantern. Entire image visibly built on one consistent low-resolution square grid, intentional pixel clusters, stair-step diagonals, limited 16-color palette, absolutely no smooth brushwork, gradients, non-grid detail or antialiasing. A complete independent scene, not a sprite sheet, no text, watermark or existing franchise characters.
assessment: 阶梯边、人物与猫的像素簇明显；天空仍有平滑调子，局部方块尺度和边缘不一致，颜色远多于16种。是像素风模拟，不是可直接交付游戏的严格像素资产。

subject: 流行方向：纵向停顿
date_note: v1.1 修订新增；独立生成示例
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One independent tall original full-color vertical webcomic page, exactly three clearly separated panels with generous clean white gutters. A simple story with one consistent adult woman in yellow coat and green scarf: top panel she waits at rainy bus stop; middle close-up she notices a small lost kitten under the bench; bottom panel she shelters kitten beneath her umbrella, smiling. Clean economical outlines, simple flat cel-color characters, restrained soft atmosphere only in background. First panel wide, middle smaller and inset, last larger emotional payoff. No speech balloons, text, existing franchise, signature or watermark.
assessment: 等待、发现和保护的三个事件清楚，最后一格面积最大；白隙仍偏短，背景摄影式光影很多，也增加了毛巾道具，未完全兑现简洁平涂和大间距的设想。

subject: 流行方向：限色海报
date_note: v1.1 修订新增；独立生成示例
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. One independent square risograph-inspired illustration for an educational book: original friendly neighborhood outdoor book swap, two adults with visibly different ages exchange a blue book above a low table with stacked books and two plant pots. Use ONLY dark indigo and fluorescent coral ink over ivory paper, overprint creates a third violet mix; coarse ink grain, clear flat shapes, subtle localized misregistration and generous blank space. No realistic shading, no extra ink colors, no typography, labels, signature or panels.
assessment: 蓝、珊瑚与局部紫的配色集中，颗粒和平面角色明显，交换动作是焦点；从生成图不能证明真实两色印版或紫色确为物理叠印。
